neighbours.label: the colon after 'Definition of <term>' in dictionary entries
fire:
Definition of quahog
: a thick-shelled edible clam of the Atlantic coast

Definition of sextant
: an instrument for measuring angular distances

Merriam-Webster. Definition of ombudsman
: a government official who investigates complaints

Definition of lichen
: a complex organism formed by a fungus and an alga

Definition of filibuster
: the use of long speeches to delay a vote

Definition of sonnet
: a fourteen-line poem with a fixed rhyme scheme

Definition of brackish
: slightly salty, as water from an estuary

Definition of marmot
: a stout burrowing rodent of the squirrel family
quiet: The quahog is a thick-shelled clam: it lives along the Atlantic coast.
Note: a sextant measures angular distances at sea.
An ombudsman has two duties: investigating complaints and reporting.
Lichen grows slowly: a fungus and an alga live together in it.
At 10:30 a.m. the senators began their filibuster.
Shakespeare wrote many sonnets: fourteen-line poems with fixed rhyme.
Warning: the water in the estuary is brackish.
Our guide said this: the marmot is a stout burrowing rodent.

notes: Card: top examples are all the ':' on the line after 'Definition of X'. Near misses keep the topic and a colon in other uses.
